summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing via Item 8.01 and Exhibit 99.1 a press release with preliminary data from a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study of ET-700, an investigational extended-release zinc acetate for Wilson disease. Treatment-related adverse events occurred in 1 of 12 ET-700 participants versus 8 of 12 GALZIN participants; hepatic copper uptake fell 12% with ET-700 versus 46% with GALZIN and rose 11% with placebo. No transaction, price, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. Additional faster-release formulation study arms are planned for 2027.
